name: brainrot-finance
description: Live market data (stocks, crypto, currency, gold and silver, private markets) and your Brainrot portfolios, from Brainrot Finance.

interface.longDescription:
Brainrot Finance brings live market data and your own investment portfolios into ChatGPT.

Look up prices and history for US and global stocks, ETFs, crypto and mutual funds; private and pre-IPO companies (Hiive, Forge Global, Nasdaq Private Market); gold and silver rates in Indian cities; money-transfer exchange rates; and Indian property circle rates.

Sign in with your Brainrot account to keep portfolios: add buys, sells and income under platforms and accounts, see every holding valued live in your base currency with totals, P&L and day change, and undo any change.

For people who track investments across brokers, countries and private markets. Prices come from third-party sources and can be delayed or unavailable; private-market prices are indicative secondary prices. Brainrot Finance is for information only and doesn't give investment advice or place trades.
defaultPrompt: Use Brainrot Finance to get Apple's latest stock price.
Use Brainrot Finance to value my portfolio in USD.
Use Brainrot Finance to check today's 24k gold rate in Mumbai.

positive.prompt: What's Apple's stock price right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns AAPL's latest price, currency, day change and market state from Brainrot Finance.

positive.prompt: What's SpaceX trading at on Hiive?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns SpaceX's latest Hiive indicative price per share and its date, noting it's a secondary-market price.

positive.description: Gold rate in an Indian city
positive.prompt: What's the 24k gold rate in Mumbai today?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns today's 24K gold rate in INR per gram and per 10 grams for Mumbai.

positive.prompt: What's my portfolio worth in USD?
positive.expected_behavior: Signed in as the test account, returns total value in USD with each holding, cash, P&L and return %.

positive.description: Add a transaction, then undo it
positive.prompt: Add a buy of 2 MSFT at $400 on 2026-01-15 to my Robinhood account, then undo it.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the MSFT buy under Robinhood, confirms it, then restores the previous version so the portfolio is unchanged.

negative.prompt: Write a haiku about autumn leaves.
What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: General finance concept with no data needed

publication.release_notes: First release: live market data (public, private, commodities, FX, circle rates) and Brainrot portfolios with live valuation and undo.
